name: Should I hire a professional contractor to install my bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a professional contractor to install my bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a simple, identical vanity swap can be attempted by experienced DIYers, hiring a professional contractor ensures structural stability, leak-free plumbing, and clean finish work. Professional installers level the cabinet across uneven floors, securely anchor the unit into wall framing studs, and handle unexpected water damage or mold discovered behind the old cabinet. When projects involve stone tops, tile backsplash installation, drywall patching, or hiring licensed trades to relocate water lines and GFCI outlets, a general finish contractor provides a single point of contact to keep the renovation code-compliant.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a contractor ensures proper wall anchoring, leak-free plumbing, level surfaces, and smooth coordination for drywall, tile, and trade work.
